description_en: Creates an IPv6 egress-only rule for an IPv6 address by calling CreateIpv6EgressOnlyRule. You can create an egress-only rule to allow ECS instances in a VPC with an IPv6 CIDR block to proactively access IPv6 endpoints on the client side, while preventing IPv6 endpoints on the client side from accessing ECS instances in the VPC over the Internet
description_zh: 您可以通过创建仅主动出规则，使开通了IPv6网段的VPC中的ECS可以主动访问客户端的IPv6终端，但不允许客户端的IPv6终端通过互联网访问VPC网络中的ECS实例，调用CreateIpv6EgressOnlyRule为IPv6地址添加仅主动出规则
kebab_example: aliyun vpc create-ipv6-egress-only-rule --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipv6-gateway-id ipv6gw-hp3c2paq0ywauasza0000 --instance-id ipv6-hp3nxjkfxn5pnhgl50000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateIpv6EgressOnlyRule

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the IPv6 gateway.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
IPv6网关的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the IPv6 gateway
parameters.name: ipv6_gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IPv6 address for which you want to create an egress-only rule
parameters.help_zh: 需要设置仅主动出规则的IPv6地址ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the instance for which you want to create an egress-only rule.

Set the value to Ipv6Address (default), which indicates the IPv6 address type
parameters.help_zh:
需要设置仅主动出规则的实例类型。

仅取值：Ipv6Address（默认值），表示为IPv6地址类型
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the egress-only rule.

The name must be 0 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
仅主动出规则的名称。

长度为0-128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the egress-only rule.

The description must be 0 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
仅主动出规则的描述。

长度为0-256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to perform a dry run without performing the actual request
parameters.name: dry_run

Ipv6EgressRuleId.description_en: The ID of the egress-only rule
